member.name: T:SPTarkov.Server.Web.IModBlazorMetadata
member.summary: This interface is used as a metadata marker to identify mod assemblies that integrate with Blazor or MVC.
member.remarks:
Implementing this interface signals to the SPT Server to:
Link the mod's wwwroot directory, enabling serving of static web assets (CSS, JS, etc.).
Register the mod's Blazor components and pages for routing within the SPT Server.
Register the mod's MVC controllers for use as APIs where necessary.

member.name: P:SPTarkov.Server.Web.IModBlazorMetadata.WWWRootUrl
member.summary: This property will allow you to set a custom directory for wwwroot, if this is left null it will use the assembly's name

member.name: T:SPTarkov.Server.Web.Services.IPasswordHasher
member.summary: Hashes and verifies web-panel account passwords.

member.name: M:SPTarkov.Server.Web.Services.IPasswordHasher.Hash(System.String)
member.summary: Hashes a plaintext password into a hash suitable for storage.

member.name: M:SPTarkov.Server.Web.Services.IPasswordHasher.Verify(System.String,System.String,System.Boolean@)
member.summary: Verifies a plaintext password against a previously stored encoded hash. Returns false for a malformed or corrupted hash.
member.param: The plaintext password supplied at login.
The stored encoded hash to verify against.

True when the password was correct but the stored hash was produced with cost parameters that differ from the current ones, so the caller should re-hash and persist it. Always false on a failed verification.

member.name: M:SPTarkov.Server.Web.Services.IPasswordHasher.IsEncodedHash(System.String)
member.summary: Returns true when the supplied value is already one of this hasher's encoded hashes, rather than a plaintext secret. Used to detect pre-hashing credentials that still need migrating.

member.name: P:SPTarkov.Server.Web.Services.IPasswordHasher.DummyHash
member.summary: A throwaway hash whose verification cost matches a real one. Verify a failed login against this so response timing is the same whether the supplied username exists.
